description: A local part that does not parse is locator_unknown and a path leaving the corpus is refused as one; a well-formed locator naming a file that is gone, or a line range past the end of the file, is locator_expired. No nearby record is ever substituted.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory, which holds the recorded qmd output and the corpus evidence is read from
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
